title: Repair Queue
job: Import Anki card or review history, find prompts with a high recent failure ratio or slow responses, and work through revise, split, suspend, or archive decisions without changing the original export.
user: Self-learners with established decks who want objective signals about which prompts need repair.
success_measure: Repair 15 flagged cards and reduce their flagged-card failure rate by 20% after four weeks.
constraints: All study history stays on the device
Do not make health or learning-disability claims
